lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Given a string S, its current base B1, and a target base B2, your task is to convert the number into the target base B2.
The input number from the string s will always be valid in its original base, B1. For bases greater than 10, use uppercase letters (A-Z).
Input
Line 1: A string S representing the number to convert.
Line 2: An integer B1 representing the current base of N.
Line 3: An integer B2 representing the target base.
Output
Line 1: The number from the string S converted into the target base, B2
Constraints
2 ≤ B1, B2 ≤ 36
S will fit within a standard 32-bit integer when converted to decimal.
Example
Input
42
10
2
Output
101010
